name: mm-pass6-group
command: for r in 1 2; do for c in "vF 4" "vF 5" "vF6 5" "vF6 6"; do set -- $c; ./kbench/kbench_$1 --variant $1-g$2 --group $2 --dtypes q4k --shapes qkv,gate,out,down --threads 4 --batch 64 | grep -v dispatch | sed "s/^RESULT {/RESULT {\"round\":$r,/"; done; for b in vF vF6; do ./kbench/kbench_$b --variant $b --dtypes q4k --shapes qkv,gate,down,head --threads 4 --batch 4,5,6 | grep -v dispatch | sed "s/^RESULT {/RESULT {\"round\":$r,/"; done; done
